taxon.note: Scientific and common names (and USDA symbol, where given) as the spec's authors wrote them, and the genus the scientific name is written in.

growth_form.note: The growth form the spec's authors chose from the plant's habit.

growth.note: Grown to six years, as the lycophytes' class form grows a clubmoss; the mat is full by then.

variants.note: The environments, conditions and seeds chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

taxon.family.note: WCVP v16's family for the accepted name.

taxon.plant_name_id.note: WCVP v16's plant_name_id for the accepted species the name resolves to (the accepted name).

traits.height_typical_m.note: A model estimate (confidence medium), as no source read gives it: a mat 1 cm to 3 cm deep, its stems prostrate (FNA).

traits.stem_length_m.note: A model estimate (confidence low), as no source read gives it: stems 5 cm to 15 cm long, irregularly forked, as in the photos; FNA gives no length.

traits.woodiness.note: Flora of North America vol. 2 (eFloras, read 2026-10-19), Selaginella arizonica: plants on rock or terrestrial, forming rather loose mats; stems prostrate.

traits.leaf_habit.note: A model estimate (confidence high), as no source read gives it: the leaves stay on, the mats greying and curling when dry and greening after rain.

traits.clonal.note: Flora of North America vol. 2 (eFloras, read 2026-10-19), Selaginella arizonica: forming rather loose mats; rhizophores borne on upperside of stem throughout.

traits.leaf_length_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 2 (eFloras, read 2026-10-19), Selaginella arizonica: underside leaves lanceolate, 2-2.5 x 0.5-0.6 mm; upperside leaves 1.9-2.25 x 0.4-0.55 mm.

traits.leaf_width_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 2 (eFloras, read 2026-10-19), Selaginella arizonica: underside leaves 2-2.5 x 0.5-0.6 mm; upperside leaves 1.9-2.25 x 0.4-0.55 mm.

traits.leaf_shape.note: Flora of North America vol. 2 (eFloras, read 2026-10-19), Selaginella arizonica: underside leaves lanceolate; upperside leaves linear-lanceolate to slightly falcate.

traits.leaf_colour.note: Flora of North America vol. 2 (eFloras, read 2026-10-19), Selaginella arizonica: leaves green; mid green in the photos; sRGB by eye.

generator.params.note: Set by hand for Arizona spikemoss from Flora of North America vol. 2: a loose mat (stems 30, clump_radius 0.1) of prostrate stems (stem_lean 80, lying for most of their length, lie 0.85) whose leaves are tightly appressed to ascending (leaf_angle 25), each fertile stem ending in a solitary strobilus 5-10 mm long, about a fourteenth of its length (raceme 0.07). The stem's length comes from stem_length_m through the class's rules; its leaves are all one size (leaf_length 0.0023, leaf_top and leaf_base 1) within the 1.9-2.5 mm, and kept three years as an evergreen's (leaf_years 3).

appearance.note: By eye from the photos (observations 138303368, 71591499, 88458739, 260222302, 87003901, 107919872, 58060547, 136357257): a loose, flat mat of forking, prostrate green stems clothed in tiny appressed leaves, short pale strobili at the tips. The leaf and strobilus cards are the lycophytes' class form's.

allometry.note: 0.02 m tall at 4 years in the open, within its sources' range, as grown. Replace with measured data before calling this species calibrated.

provenance.notes: Procedural proxy added for the Saguaro desert scene (west bajada of Saguaro National Park's Tucson Mountain District, about 750 m), batch s1b (2026-10-19): sizes and forms from FEIS, Kearney and Peebles, Hitchcock and Flora of North America, counts and colours from photos.
